codex.aetherium.title: 📖 ENCYCLOPEDIA — AETHERIUM ODYSSEY
codex.aetherium.section1: 1. ORES: Aetherium (Overworld Y -64 to 48), Pyrosite (Nether), Voidite (End). Smelt or combine with Diamond/Netherite.
codex.aetherium.section2: 2. WEAPONS & TOOLS: Aetherium Blade (Wave), Pyrosite Greatsword (Supernova), Void Scythe (Life Steal & Blink), 3x3 Pickaxe + Radar.
codex.aetherium.section3: 3. MAGIC & RELICS: Staves (Tempest, Meteors, Grace), Wind Talisman, Velocity Ring, Phoenix Amulet, Magnet Charm.
codex.aetherium.section4: 4. SPECIAL BLOCKS: Ascension Altar (Rituals & Boss), Regeneration Pylon (AoE Heal), Teleport Elevator (Right-click = Up, Sneak = Down).
codex.aetherium.section5: 5. FINAL BOSS: Craft the Archon Invocation Seal and use it on the Ascension Altar to fight The Aetherium Archon (3 Phases) for the Celestial Core!
